title: On Wrapping the bread in a clean cloth
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：wrap　|　正文 360 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wrap 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the coach ① wrapped the bread in a clean cloth year after year, and every player in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the coach ② wraps the bread in a clean cloth for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ wrap the bread in a clean cloth at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ wrapped the bread in a clean cloth before — a line in the record for April 1962 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Wrapping the bread in a clean cloth year after year, the coach said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the whistle at the far stand, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ wrap the rope round every post for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Wrap the rope round every post at once and never mention it again.

By 1975 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new player from the next field ⑧ wraps the rope round every post year after year every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stand, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ wrapped the bread in a clean cloth again when nobody else would.

⑩ To wrap the bread in a clean cloth, my mother said in 1980, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody wraps the bread in a clean cloth for the whole place again and somebody must wrap the bread in a clean cloth year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 包裹（一般过去式 wrapped the bread in a clean cloth：1968 年教练头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 包裹（一般现在 wraps the bread in a clean cloth：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 包裹（不定式 to wrap the bread in a clean cloth：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 包裹（过去完成时 had wrapped the bread in a clean cloth：1962 年四月的赛事记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 包裹（动名词 wrapping the bread in a clean cloth 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 缠绕（wrap the rope round every post：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去缠绕把绳子绕在每根柱子上）
G. v. 缠绕（wrap the rope round every post：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 包裹（后段两处：新来的队员照例 wraps the rope round every post，而母亲又一次 wrapped the bread in a clean cloth）

wrap 意为“包裹”，结尾那句是母亲 1980 年的话：要包裹用一块净布把面包包好，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和球场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 wrap 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1968 the coach wrapped the bread in a clean cloth year after year, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the coach wraps the bread in a clean cloth for the whole place whenever the field asks.
Wrapping the bread in a clean cloth year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever wrap the rope round every post for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new player from the next field wraps the rope round every post year after year every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother wrapped the bread in a clean cloth again, and the field remembered that half.
